classifier.verdict: classifier matched all 41 recorded ticket cases

workerTierVerdict: default handles normal orders requiring judgment; mechanical handles merge-forward work, known conflict lists, and reviewer-directed test experiments; deep handles large tickets; max handles review rounds after one failed round; ultra is never used because it delegates to its own agents
workerModelSource: resolveWorkerInvocation(config.worker, ..., tier) in tools/lib/orchestrator-config.mjs for every configured tier, with each exact launch vector: engine args, then selected profile args, then the model
